heading: National random sample study of child welfare

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Secretary shall conduct (directly, or by grant, contract, or interagency agreement) a national study based on random samples of children who are at risk of child abuse or neglect, or are determined by States to have been abused or neglected.

tree.heading: Requirements
tree.text: The study required by subsection (a) shall—

children.text: yield data reliable at the State level for as many States as the Secretary determines is feasible.

tree.heading: Preferred contents
tree.text: In conducting the study required by subsection (a), the Secretary should—

children.text: carefully consider selecting the sample from cases of confirmed abuse or neglect; and
follow each case for several years while obtaining information on, among other things—
the type of abuse or neglect involved;
the frequency of contact with State or local agencies;
whether the child involved has been separated from the family, and, if so, under what circumstances;
the number, type, and characteristics of out-of-home placements of the child; and
the average duration of each placement.

children.heading: In general
children.text: From time to time, the Secretary shall prepare reports summarizing the results of the study required by subsection (a).

children.heading: Availability
children.text: The Secretary shall make available to the public any report prepared under paragraph (1), in writing or in the form of an electronic data tape.

children.heading: Authority to charge fee
children.text: The Secretary may charge and collect a fee for the furnishing of reports under paragraph (2).

tree.heading: Appropriation
tree.text: Out of any money in the Treasury of the United States not otherwise appropriated, there are appropriated to the Secretary for each of fiscal years 1996 through 2002 $6,000,000 to carry out this section.

notes.text: Prior ProvisionsA prior section 429 of act Aug. 14, 1935, was renumbered section 426(c) and is classified to section 626(c) of this title.

Amendments1997—Pub. L. 105–33, § 5592(a)(1)(C), transferred section in original to end of this subpart. Subsec. (a). Pub. L. 105–33, § 5591(a), inserted “(directly, or by grant, contract, or interagency agreement)” after “conduct”.
